title: Stars and Stripes | KEY.co
description_expanded: Stars and Stripes offers a beautifully remodeled retreat in the heart of Seagrove, blending modern elegance with coastal charm. This four-bedroom, three-bathroom haven is thoughtfully designed to accommodate families and groups, featuring two luxurious king suites with en-suite baths, a cozy bunk room, and a convenient first-floor queen suite. The open-concept living space is bathed in natural light, showcasing soaring 12-foot ceilings, high-end finishes, and a fully equipped gourmet kitchen complete with granite countertops, custom tiles, and stainless-steel appliances. Whether you're preparing a family meal or gathering around the kitchen's bar seating, every moment here feels elevated and inviting. Nestled amidst Seagrove’s lush oaks and magnolias, this home is just a short stroll from the Gulf Coast's sugar-white sands and emerald waters. With its perfect location, guests can explore nearby treasures like Deer Lake State Park, the Timpoochee Trail, and Seagrove’s renowned dining spots, including Café Thirty-A and Old Florida Fish House. Boutique shopping, casual cafés, and the tranquil beauty of the area promise a quintessential 30A experience. With easy access to two nearby beach entry points, this home provides the perfect gateway to adventure, relaxation, and creating cherished memories along Florida’s iconic Emerald Coast.

Features: This home includes two parking spaces.

all: This home includes two parking spaces.
